# `base/toolbar`

A persistent group of related actions or controls needs one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A persistent group of related actions or controls needs one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.
- **Avoid when:** The actions open from a trigger, select one value, or navigate between pages.
- **Consider instead:** `base/action-menu`, `base/toggle`, `base/navigation`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Toolbar } from "themelia-ui/base/toolbar"
import "themelia-ui/base/toolbar.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/buttons`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### Formatting controls

```tsx fragment — excerpt from the live preview; surrounding values are supplied by the application
<Toolbar aria-label="Formatting">
  <ToolbarGroup>
    <ToolbarButton iconOnly aria-label="Bold"><BoldIcon /></ToolbarButton>
    <ToolbarButton iconOnly aria-label="Italic"><ItalicIcon /></ToolbarButton>
  </ToolbarGroup>
  <ToolbarSeparator />
```
